about: Rawdon is a municipality in Lanaudière, Quebec, in the foothills of the Laurentians north of Montréal. Waterfalls, forest lakes, and an English- and French-speaking village heritage define a popular weekend and cottage destination. About 11,000 people live in Rawdon.
seoSummary: Lanaudière Laurentian-foothills municipality north of Montréal—waterfalls, lakes, and bilingual village country.
